arxiv-2011-12870.title: Multimodal Learning for Hateful Memes Detection
arxiv-2011-12870.creator: Yi Zhou, Zhenhao Chen
arxiv-2011-12870.description: Abstract Memes are used for spreading ideas through social networks. Although most memes are created for humor, some memes become hateful under the combination of pictures and text. Automatically detecting the hateful memes can help reduce their harmful social impact.

arxiv-2302-02111.title: A method to measure the quenching factor for recoil energy of oxygen in bismuth germanium oxide scintillators
arxiv-2302-02111.creator: and Masaki Ishitsuka
arxiv-2302-02111.description: Abstract Bismuth germanium oxide ( Bi 4 ​ Ge 3 ​ O 12 \rm Bi_{4}Ge_{3}O_{12} , BGO) scintillation crystals are widely used as detectors in the fields of particle physics and astrophysics due to their high density, and thus higher efficiency for gamma-ray detection. Owing to their good chemical stability, they can be used in any environment.

arxiv-2401-10633.title: Assessment of the Axial Resolution of a Compact Gamma Camera with Coded Aperture Collimator
arxiv-2401-10633.creator: Tobias Meißner, Laura Antonia Cerbone, Paolo Russo, Werner Nahm, Jürgen Hesser
arxiv-2401-10633.description: Abstract Purpose: Handheld gamma cameras with coded aperture collimators are under investigation for intraoperative imaging in nuclear medicine. Coded apertures are a promising collimation technique for applications such as lymph node localization due to their high sensitivity and the possibility of 3D imaging. We evaluated the axial resolution and computational performance of two reconstruction methods.

arxiv-2402-01009.title: Denotational Foundations for Expected Cost Analysis Note: For the purpose of Open Access the author has applied a CC BY public copyright licence to any Author Accepted Manuscript version arising from this submission.
arxiv-2402-01009.creator: Pedro H. Azevedo de Amorim
arxiv-2402-01009.description: Abstract . Reasoning about the cost of executing programs is one of the fundamental questions in computer science. In the context of programming with probabilities, however, the notion of cost stops being deterministic, since it depends on the probabilistic samples made throughout the execution of the program.

arxiv-2507-00086.title: Test mass charge management in the detection of gravitational waves in space based on UV micro-LED
arxiv-2507-00086.creator: Yuandong Jia, Zhihao Zhang, Yinbowen Zhang, Yuning Gu, Suwen Wang, Guozhi Chai, Zemin Zhang, Yi Zhang, Shanduan Zhang, Hongqing Huo, Zongfeng Li, Pengfei Tian, Yun Kau Lau
arxiv-2507-00086.description: Abstract As an alternative to the ultraviolet light emitting diode(UV LED), the feasibility of utilizing UV micro-LED in the charge management in the detection of gravitational waves in space is experimentally studied. Compared with UV LED, micro-LED is more compact in size, has better current spreading, faster response time and longer operating life.

arxiv-2507-21542.title: Stable Cosmology from Minimal Theory of Mass-Varying Massive Gravity
arxiv-2507-21542.creator: Ahmad Khoirul Falah, Andy Octavian Latief, Husin Alatas, Bobby Eka Gunara
arxiv-2507-21542.description: Abstract We study cosmological perturbations in the minimal theory of mass-varying massive gravity (MTMVMG), a constrained extension of mass-varying massive gravity that propagates only three physical degrees of freedom. We show that MTMVMG admits a stable cosmological solutions i.e. free from ghost, gradient, and tachyonic instabilities around the homogeneous and isotropic background.

pmc-11284960.title: Defining the minimal clinically important difference for IKDC and KOOS scores for patients undergoing tibial tubercle osteotomy for patellofemoral pain or instability
pmc-11284960.creator: Julia S Retzky, Aakash K Shah, Ava G Neijna, Morgan E Rizy, Andreas H Gomoll, Sabrina M Strickland
pmc-11284960.description: PurposeThe aim of the present study is to define the minimal clinically important difference (MCID) for International Knee Documentation Committee (IKDC) and Knee Injury and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score (KOOS) for patients undergoing tibial tubercle osteotomy (TTO) for either (1) patellofemoral pain or (2) patellar instability.

pmc-11618688.title: Transparent ultrasonic transducers based on relaxor ferroelectric crystals for advanced photoacoustic imaging
pmc-11618688.creator: Chaorui Qiu, Zhiqiang Zhang, Zhiqiang Xu, Liao Qiao, Li Ning, Shujun Zhang, Min Su, Weichang Wu, Kexin Song, Zhuo Xu, Long-Qing Chen, Hairong Zheng, Chengbo Liu, Weibao Qiu, Fei Li
pmc-11618688.description: Photoacoustic imaging is a promising non-invasive functional imaging modality for fundamental research and clinical diagnosis. However, achieving capillary-level resolution, wide field-of-view, and high frame rates remains challenging. To address this, we propose a transparent ultrasonic transducer design using our developed transparent Pb(In1/2Nb1/2)O3-Pb(Mg1/3Nb2/3)O3-PbTiO3 crystals.

pmc-12475576.title: Therapeutic potential of 5HT2CR in alleviating spasticity and pain via modulation of motor neurons and interneurons in spinal cord injury
pmc-12475576.creator: Han Gong, Zuliyaer Talifu, Yu-Zhe Sun, Zhao-Ming Yue, Xiao-Xia Du, Liang-Jie Du
pmc-12475576.description: SummaryNumerous adverse outcomes can be resulted in limb spasm and spasticity that occur after spinal cord injury (SCI). Here, we used adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors and Cre-driver transgenic mice to selectively overexpress 5-hydroxytryptamine2C receptor (5HT2CR) in motor, GABAergic, and Glutamatergic interneurons.

pmc-12579290.title: Workplace Health Interventions Targeting Cardiovascular Diseases and Diabetes Mellitus for Blue-Collar Workers: Protocol for a Scoping Review
pmc-12579290.creator: Chiara Di Girolamo, Agnieszka Lipiak, Matteo Franco, Krzysztof Kaczmarek, Guillermo Barreres-Martín, Piotr Romaniuk, Carles Muñoz-Alfonso, Andrea Arroyo-Álvarez, Federica Turatto, Daznia Bompart Berroterán, Ewelina Chawłowska, Javad Sarvestan, Marc Damen
pmc-12579290.description: BackgroundCardiometabolic diseases, such as cardiovascular diseases (CVD) and diabetes mellitus (DM), represent a global health issue, causing significant premature mortality and disability. Blue-collar workers, who often face a higher exposure to risk factors (eg, smoking, poor diet, and lack of physical activity), are particularly vulnerable to these diseases.

pmc-13361757.title: Epitranscriptomic Analysis of A-to-I RNA Editing and m6A Using Short- and Long-Read Sequencing Technologies
pmc-13361757.creator: Nicholas Brenna, Domenico Alessandro Silvestris, Silvana Zugaro, Elena Orecchini, Enrica Crivaro, Laura Leo, Angela Gallo
pmc-13361757.description: More than 160 types of post-transcriptional RNA modifications have been identified, revealing considerable diversity in their types, abundances, distributions, and functional roles across different RNAs, cells, and tissues in humans. Recent advances in high-throughput sequencing technologies have enabled the systematic detection of dynamic RNA modifications, including N6-methyladenosine (m6A) and inosine (I).

pmc-13415386.title: Nanocarrier-Mediated Non-Invasive Drug Delivery for Wet Age-Related Macular Degeneration: Advances and Translational Challenges
pmc-13415386.creator: Shasha Wang, Linfei Liu, Xiaoling Zeng, Chonghui Tang, Wei Chen, Xuri Li, Weisi Lu
pmc-13415386.description: Wet age-related macular degeneration (wAMD) is characterized by choroidal neovascularization (CNV) and remains a major cause of severe vision loss in older adults. Intravitreal anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF) therapy is the current standard of care for wAMD. However, repeated injections are associated with poor adherence, procedure-related complications, and a substantial cumulative treatment burden.

pmc-13511806.title: Relationship Between Anxiety Levels, Care Dependency, and Quality of Recovery in Patients Undergoing Orthopedic Surgery
pmc-13511806.creator: Durdane Yılmaz Güven, Büşra Salar
pmc-13511806.description: Background and Objectives: Postoperative recovery after orthopedic surgery is associated with psychological and functional factors, yet the independent associations of anxiety and care dependency with postoperative recovery remain unclear. This study aimed to identify factors independently associated with postoperative quality of recovery and to examine the relationships among anxiety, care dependency, and recovery quality.

pmc-13611058.title: Beyond Clear Margins: Oncologic Risk and Reconstructive Planning in Head and Neck Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma—A Structured Narrative Review
pmc-13611058.creator: Iris-Iuliana Adam, Liliana Vecerzan, Bogdan Moldovan, Raluca-Gabriela Miulescu, Alexandru-Petru Ciucu, Alina-Bianca Iacob, Alina Ormenișan
pmc-13611058.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Head and neck cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (HNcSCC) presents intersecting oncologic, functional, and reconstructive challenges. Although numerous clinicopathologic factors have been associated with recurrence, metastasis, and survival, their relationship with reconstructive complexity and patient-centered outcomes remains insufficiently studied. This review aimed to examine how established oncologic risk factors might inform reconstructive planning while distinguishing measured reconstructive evidence from hypothesis-generating clinical inferences.
